import argparse
from pathlib import Path

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument('paths', nargs='+')
ap.add_argument('--dry-run', action='store_true')
args = ap.parse_args()

for p in args.paths:
    path = Path(p)
    if args.dry_run:
        print(f'[dry] {{op_name}} {path}')
    else:
        print(f'{{op_name}} {path}')
        path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
